messages:
incident-bot: P0 Pager triggered — SmartRouting oscillation detected in ap-southeast1. Elevated 502s on /v1/chat when tool_call=true. Possible fallback loop, customers reporting failed function/tool calls and repeated retries. Pager: ena oncall.

ena: Ack. Jumping in. Moving to #incidents channel and grabbing traces. :rotating_light:

ena: Initial signal: requests that require tool_call are being routed to quantized variants in ap-southeast1 which return unsupported-invocation. SmartRoute retries across regions and we see fallback thrash and rate-limit errors.

sanjay: Snippet from routing decisions/logging:

```
[smartroute] request_id=xyz model_pool=ap-southeast1 policy=cost_preference selected_variant=redwood-open-quant8 tool_call_supported=false
[smartroute] fallback-> region=ap-northeast1 selected_variant=redwood-open-quant8 tool_call_supported=false
[runtime] ERROR unsupported-invocation: variant lacks toolcall hooks
```

sanjay: Compat matrix seemed to indicate quant8 supports tool_call, but runtime disagrees.

maya: How many tenants impacted? Severity? :eyes:

cs: CS triage: 3 Dedicated tenants in APAC hit hard; several Hosted enterprise routes also affected. Received multiple 502s on chat->function calls. Two tenant support tickets opened.

ena: Short-term mitigation options:
- Disable smart-routing in ap-southeast1 for routes with tool_call=true (force region pin)
- Or change policy to prefer_latency for tool_call requests to avoid cost-preference picking quant variants

sanjay: I can push a one-line policy toggle in the config service. Will coordinate with infra for safe rollout.

ops-bot: Executing playbook: notify infra oncall, snapshot compat-matrix, escalate to runtime team.

ops-bot: Query compat-matrix (variants where name like 'redwood-open-quant%'):

```
service: compat-matrix
query: SELECT name, quantized, tool_call_support FROM variants WHERE name LIKE 'redwood-open-quant%'
result:
  - name: redwood-open-quant8
    quantized: true
    tool_call_support: true   # <-- appears incorrect
  - name: redwood-open-fp16
    quantized: false
    tool_call_support: true
```

sanjay: That true flag for quant8 is wrong. Runtime has no toolcall hooks for the quant path.

deploy-bot: Opened PR redwood/compat-matrix#456 to fix detection logic for tool_call support on quantized builds. Running unit tests.

ena: While PR runs, I'm going to apply a routing override: prevent smart-routing from selecting quantized variants when tool_call=true.

ryan: I’ll own the policy rollout. Canary at 10% first, then scale to 100% if stable.

(5m later)

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-service/policy-toggle@canary — CI green.

ryan: Canary metrics look good. Tool_call error rate in ap-southeast1 dropped from ~18% -> ~1.2%. Rolling to 100%.

deploy-bot: canary -> prod completed.

cs: Notified affected customers with a brief note: identified routing/compat mismatch causing tool calls to fail, mitigation applied, investigating root cause. CS requesting postmortem and comp assessment.

sanjay: Compat-matrix PR merged and hotfixed. New matrix rows now reflect correct capabilities.

ops-bot: Post-hotfix matrix check:
```
redwood-open-quant8 -> tool_call_support: false
redwood-open-fp16   -> tool_call_support: true
```

ena: Preliminary root cause: regression in onboarding pipeline defaulted tool_call_support=true for quantized builds. SmartRouting relies on compat-matrix; because quant variants were incorrectly marked as supporting tool_call, cost-preference policy picked them leading to runtime errors and fallback loops.

maya: Impact window?

ena: First anomalous trace ~1734509000 UTC. Mitigation in place by 1734513200. Total impact ~47 minutes. Approx 22k requests across 3 tenants affected. 95th percentile token latency for affected requests spiked ~3x.

cs: Customers X and Y flagged as impacted; CS will follow up for remediation and potential credits. No evidence of data exfiltration.

ryan: Handoff to next oncall: @sanjay — please own follow-ups and the postmortem. Action items:
- Add CI check in model-onboard pipeline to verify runtime capability flags for tool_call and context_length
- Add an alert when compat-matrix and runtime capability delta > 0
- Add canary gating when compat flags change for quant variants

sanjay: Ack. Will draft postmortem and sync with research/quant team to ensure either toolcall shim for quant path or explicit unsupported flagging at build time.

ena: Thanks all. Closing the incident channel after postmortem link is posted. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Final handoff note: mitigation active, customers notified, compat-matrix hotfixed, and policy restored with a guard for tool_call=true. Filing follow-ups under RW-INC-7123.
